attacks.name: Cursed Drop
attacks.effect: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

abilities.name: Empty Shell
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out, your opponent can’t take any Prize cards for it.

attacks.name: Curse and Deceive
attacks.effect: Put 3 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. If Shedinja has any damage counters on it, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

abilities.name: Resent
abilities.effect: Once during your opponent's turn, if Shedinja would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may put 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon and each of your opponent's Pokémon that has the same name as the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Damage Beat
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Fragile Husk
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ex, your opponent can't take any Prize cards for it.

attacks.name: Damage Beat
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Fragile Husk
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ex, your opponent can't take any Prize cards for it.

attacks.name: Spike Wound
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Marvel Shell
abilities.effect: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Shedinja by your opponent's Pokémon that has any Poké-Powers or Poké-Bodies.

attacks.name: Haunt
attacks.effect: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Vessel of Life
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard all cards attached to this Pokémon and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon as a Pokémon Tool card. When the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 1 fewer Prize card.

attacks.name: Life Squeeze
attacks.effect: Put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 10.

abilities.name: Shell Survival
abilities.effect: Put this Pokémon into play only with the effect of Ninjask's Cast-Off Shell Ability. (When you are setting up to play, you cannot put it face down as your Active Pokémon or on your Bench.)

attacks.name: Cursed Rain
attacks.effect: Put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hopeless Scream
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 damage times the number of damage counters on this Pokémon.
